summary: Iteration-2 testing for راهکار. Backend: 27/31 passed (4 failures rooted in 1 bug). Form-tabs + visible_if + structured conditional edges persist correctly. evaluate_rule engine logic (empty/numeric coercion/contains/empty/not_empty/>) all pass at unit level. CRITICAL: POST /api/workflows/{id}/start does NOT invoke advance_process from the trigger node, so the first form-task at n2 is never created — end-to-end spec for iteration 2 is broken. Frontend: Form Builder (Live Preview tab switcher, palette including تب گروهی, nested fields per tab) works. Workflow Builder edge inspector opens with structured Edge Rule Builder for the conditional edge between n3→n4 in تنخواه. Seed correctly contains 3 forms incl. فرم درخواست خدمات (پشتیبانی) with 14 fields & 5-tab tabs field, and تنخواه workflow with 6 nodes / 6 edges incl. structured condition.

critical.issue: Endpoint creates ProcessInstance with current_node_id=trigger node but does NOT call advance_process(). As a result, no downstream task is auto-created when a workflow is started. The spec requires kicking off the engine from the trigger so the form task at n2 appears immediately. Fix: after insert_one(instance), call `await advance_process(process_id=instance.id, completed_node_id=first_node.id)` and merge the returned next_tasks into the response, OR change response to {process, advanced}. Currently breaks the iteration-2 E2E spec (employee never sees the form task after start).

minor.issue: Iteration-1 issue still present: workflow=null if workflow was deleted (no FK cascade).
No validation that workflow.status == 'published'; draft workflows can be started.

Process completion logic: when next_tasks is empty and there is no explicit 'end' target (e.g., chain ends with a 'task' node whose only outgoing edge points to 'end'), the engine ALREADY walks past end correctly via has_end. But it sets new_current = next_tasks[0]['node_id'] when has_action is true, even if the workflow also has an 'end' branch in parallel — minor edge case for parallel splits.

integration_issues.issue: Because backend doesn't invoke engine on start, clicking 'اجرا' in Workflow Builder will create a process but the assigned employee will never see the form task in their inbox until something else creates it manually.

design_issues.screen: Form Builder — Live Preview date field
issues: Date input uses browser-native picker (mm/dd/yyyy format) instead of a Persian Jalali/shadcn calendar component — inconsistent with the otherwise fully Persian RTL UX.
Initial mount sometimes renders canvas off-center (nodes appear bottom-edge of viewport before fit-view). Consider calling fitView() once on mount after nodes load.

action_items: CRITICAL: In /app/backend/server.py start_workflow(), after persisting the instance, invoke `await advance_process(process_id=instance.id, completed_node_id=first_node['id'])` so the first downstream task is auto-created. Optionally return {process, advanced} similar to PATCH /api/tasks.
Optional: Validate workflow.status == 'published' before allowing /start, returning 400 otherwise (drafts shouldn't be runnable).

Frontend polish: replace native HTML date input in FormRenderer with a Persian Jalali date picker (shadcn DatePicker + persian-date adapter, or a lightweight react-multi-date-picker) to match the rest of the RTL UX.
Frontend polish: call rfInstance.fitView() once after workflow loads in WorkflowBuilder so the canvas centers automatically.
critical_code_review_comments: engine.advance_process is well-structured: separates conditional vs default edges, supports pass-through 'condition' nodes, walks frontier safely with `visited` set. Good code.
VisibilityRule and TabOption pydantic models are clean and reused between forms (visible_if) and edges (condition) — nice DRY.
server.start_workflow seeds context with {'requester': user.full_name} but the trigger is never advanced — the engine has no way to create the first task. This is the single biggest gap.
PATCH /api/tasks correctly merges form_data into process context and synthesises '_task_status' for rule evaluation — matches the spec.
Rejection short-circuits the process and skips advance_process; consider also logging which task triggered the rejection in process_instance for audit (currently only activity log).

success_rate.backend: 87% (27/31 — 3 failures all rooted in the one start-workflow engine bug; 1 fixed during this run)

seed_data_creation: Seed wipes & reseeds when 'فرم درخواست خدمات (پشتیبانی)' is missing — verified. Seeds 3 forms, 2 workflows (مرخصی, تنخواه — تنخواه has 6 nodes/6 edges incl. structured conditional edge e3 with op '>' and value '5000000'), 1 running process instance with 4 tasks, 3 activities.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter2.py covers: seed for tabs form, conditional edge presence, form CRUD with tabs+visible_if round-trip, engine.evaluate_rule unit cases, and three E2E flows (above-threshold/below-threshold/rejection). The three E2E tests currently fail at the very first assertion (employee has no task after start) because /api/workflows/{id}/start never triggers advance_process. Once main agent adds the one-line fix, ALL three E2E tests should pass without modification. backend_test.py was also updated to match the new {task, advanced} shape returned by PATCH /api/tasks (this fix is already applied and passing).
rca of the issue: Root cause: /api/workflows/{id}/start in server.py (lines 147–164) only inserts the ProcessInstance and writes an activity log. It never invokes the engine to evaluate the trigger node's outgoing edges and create the first downstream task. Reproduction: 1) POST /api/workflows/{petty_id}/start as designer → 200 with current_node_id=n1. 2) GET /api/processes/{pid} → tasks=[]. 3) GET /api/tasks?assigned_to_me=true as employee → 0 new tasks. Mitigation (one-line fix): inside start_workflow after `await db.process_instances.insert_one(instance.to_mongo())`, add: `advanced = await advance_process(process_id=instance.id, completed_node_id=first_node['id'])`. Return {process: instance, advanced: advanced} (or keep current shape and silently advance). After this fix, the E2E tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iter2.py::TestEngineE2E will pass without any test modifications because the engine logic itself is verified working by the evaluate_rule unit tests.
